name: Balloon guidewire
full_name: Tendon-driven steerable guidewire with retractable distal balloon (+ handheld actuation)
versions: 2025 balloon guidewire (barre2025_towards); 2026 handheld actuation mechanism for tendon-driven guidewire, 0.836 kg, up to 1.5 m of wire, joystick feed/roll/bend (chavenet2026_handheld)
target_anatomy: endovascular, phantom vessel 3 mm ID with three branches
devices_driven: own notched-nitinol tendon guidewire (0.48 mm OD nitinol tube, 20 mm UAN bending segment, 76 um nitinol tendon in 2026 paper); balloon wire uses 0.15 mm nitinol tendon
n_dof_detail: bend, feed, roll (handheld); plus balloon inflation (2025)
device_range: up to 1.5 m of wire spooled (2026)
imaging_compat: C-arm in phantom test; MR compatibility N.R.
validation_detail: 2025: phantom vessel under pulsatile flow, traversal, balloon inflation, flow arrest (one demonstration); 2026: one navigation of an abdominal aorta phantom, wire buckled between phantom entry and device (abstract-level counts N.R.)
key_numbers: balloon radii inflated 0.75-2.50 mm in 0.25 mm steps; 1.22 mm OD balloon on guidewire; Abaqus model of balloon inflation; pressure-channel test: position change 0.038 mm and curvature change 0.2 % (barre2025 Sec. V, context only partly read)
sim_model: Abaqus FE model of balloon inflation plus analytical curvature model (barre2025 Sec. III-IV, partial read)
